dialogues.speaker: Amauta
dialogues.text: It depends on what kind of work you have to do. For me, having more work is undoubtedly a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Amauta
dialogues.text: Well, you see, I'm the one responsible for making and repairing sports equipment for our tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Amauta
dialogues.text: Things like hooks, locks, and protective gear. If you need anything, just holler. You'd basically be supporting my business.

dialogues.speaker: Amauta
dialogues.text: And, well, the more business I have, the more people there are hoping to get their hands on my equipment.

dialogues.speaker: Amauta
dialogues.text: But that's always better than having no customers at all.
